anchors.reason: Paper describes a smartphone-based 19-channel EEG hardware system (ADS1299) and its evaluation; a technical/device paper likely tied to the acquisition equipment, not this n-back dataset.

metadata.methods_description: EEG was recorded with a 19-channel 10-20 montage using Ag/AgCl electrodes with linked-ear reference at 250 Hz, with impedance checks and Neurogel applied. ECG was recorded via a 3-lead configuration on the same mobile system. Pupillometry data were collected using a Pupil Labs Pupil Core eye tracker with infrared illuminators, relayed asynchronously via LSL. The n-back task included a tutorial phase with feedback (20 trials per level) and a main experiment (100 trials per level) without feedback, with each trial presenting a letter for 1.0 s followed by a 0.7 s blank interval.
